intro: This unit is about leisure activities — Beijing opera, Chinese chess, square dancing, theme parks. Grammar: (1) 别说……，就是……也…… “let alone…, even… (still)…”; (2) the three uses of 差点儿 “almost”; (3) 我说呢！ “No wonder!”. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.en: The martial plays are simply wonderful.

key_sentences.zh: 我更喜欢文戏，唱腔很美，服装也漂亮。
key_sentences.py: Wǒ gèng xǐhuan wénxì, chàngqiāng hěn měi, fúzhuāng yě piàoliang.
key_sentences.en: I prefer the singing plays — the singing is beautiful and the costumes are lovely.

key_sentences.zh: 在美国别说在街边坐着下棋，就是走路的人都很少。
key_sentences.py: Zài Měiguó biéshuō zài jiē biān zuòzhe xià qí, jiùshì zǒu lù de rén dōu hěn shǎo.
key_sentences.en: In America, never mind sitting on the street playing chess — there are hardly even any pedestrians.

key_sentences.zh: 真可惜，他差点儿就赢了。
key_sentences.py: Zhēn kěxī, tā chàdiǎnr jiù yíng le.
key_sentences.en: What a pity — he very nearly won.

key_sentences.zh: 中国有句俗话：观棋不语真君子。意思是看别人下棋时不能支招儿。
key_sentences.py: Zhōngguó yǒu jù súhuà: guān qí bù yǔ zhēn jūnzǐ. Yìsi shì kàn biérén xià qí shí bù néng zhī zhāor.
key_sentences.en: There's a Chinese saying: a true gentleman watches chess in silence — meaning you mustn't give advice while watching others play.

title.en: The usage of 别说……，就是……也……

body.zh: 这个结构中“别说”的意思是“何况、不用说”，“就是”表示假设的让步，“也”引出结论或评论。一般是用“就是”后面的例子来强调说明“别说”后面的例子。从逻辑上来说，如果“也”后边的结论或评论可以适用于“就是”后面的例子，那么它也一定能适用于“别说”后面的例子。例如：
body.en: Here “别说” means “let alone / needless to say”, “就是” introduces a hypothetical concession (“even”), and “也” introduces the conclusion. The example after “就是” is used to emphasise the one after “别说”: logically, if the conclusion after “也” holds for the 就是-example, it must also hold for the 别说-example. For example:

body.zh: 别说 + （明显的情况），就是 + （更极端的情况）+ 也／都 + 结论
body.py: biéshuō + (míngxiǎn de qíngkuàng), jiùshì + (gèng jíduān de qíngkuàng) + yě / dōu + jiélùn
body.en: never mind (the obvious case); even (the extreme case) + 也 + conclusion

body.zh: 别说写汉字，就是读，他也不会。
body.py: Biéshuō xiě Hànzì, jiùshì dú, tā yě bú huì.
body.en: Never mind writing characters — he can't even read them.

body.zh: 别说大人，就是小孩子也懂得这个道理。
body.py: Biéshuō dàrén, jiùshì xiǎo háizi yě dǒngde zhège dàolǐ.
body.en: Not just adults — even small children understand this.

body.zh: 别说一天，就是一个星期也做不完这么多工作啊！
body.py: Biéshuō yì tiān, jiùshì yí ge xīngqī yě zuò bu wán zhème duō gōngzuò a!
body.en: Forget one day — you couldn't finish this much work even in a week!
The 就是 example must be the harder/more extreme one: kids understanding it proves adults do (✓ 别说大人，就是小孩儿也明白); a week not being enough proves a day isn't (✓ 别说一天，就是一个星期也做不完).

body.zh: 副词“差点儿”有以下三种用法：
body.en: The adverb “差点儿” has three uses:

body.zh: 1）表示某种不希望发生的事情接近发生而实际没有发生。动词用肯定式或否定式意思相同。如：
body.en: 1) Something you did NOT want nearly happened, but didn't. Positive and negative verb forms mean the same thing here, e.g.,
I was almost late. (but I wasn't)
I nearly fell over. (but I didn't — same meaning as 差点儿摔倒)

body.zh: 2）表示某种希望发生的事情似乎不会发生而终于发生了。动词用否定式。例如：
body.en: 2) Something you WANTED seemed not to be going to happen, but in the end it did. Use the negative verb form, e.g.,
(We) very nearly didn't win the championship. (but we did)
I almost missed the plane. (but I caught it)

body.zh: 3）表示某种希望发生的事情接近发生而实际上没有发生。动词用肯定式，前面常用“就”。例如：
body.en: 3) Something you WANTED nearly happened, but didn't. Use the positive verb form, often with “就” before it, e.g.,

body.zh: 我差点儿就赶上这班航班了。
body.py: Wǒ chàdiǎnr jiù gǎnshàng zhè bān hángbān le.
body.en: I very nearly caught this flight. (but I missed it)

body.zh: 我差点儿就可以赢他了。
body.py: Wǒ chàdiǎnr jiù kěyǐ yíng tā le.
body.en: I almost beat him. (but I didn't)
Rule of thumb: for something good, 差点儿没 + verb = it did happen (phew!); 差点儿就 + verb = it didn't (so close!). For something bad, 差点儿 and 差点儿没 both mean it didn't happen. Never 差点儿不 + verb.

body.zh: 日常口语表达结构。是说话人最终知道一件事情的缘由后发出的感慨。例如：
body.en: An everyday spoken expression: what you exclaim when you finally learn the reason for something (“No wonder! / So that's why!”), e.g.,

lines.speaker: B
lines.py: Wǒ shuō ne! Zuìjìn méi kànjiàn tā.
lines.en: No wonder I haven't seen him lately!

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我说呢！一起吃饭时，她从来不吃鸡蛋。
lines.py: Wǒ shuō ne! Yìqǐ chī fàn shí, tā cónglái bù chī jīdàn.
lines.en: That explains it! She never eats eggs when we eat together.

body.en: After 我说呢, mention the thing that puzzled you before and now makes sense (often with 怪不得): ✓ 我说呢，怪不得这几天没看见他. ✗ 我说呢，他常常生病 (that doesn't connect a reason to an earlier puzzle).

title.zh: 他们可以完成这些任务吗？
title.py: Tāmen kěyǐ wánchéng zhèxiē rènwu ma?

instructions.zh: 讨论表格中的人物能否完成指定的任务。
instructions.en: Discuss whether each person can do the task, using 别说……，就是……也…….

body.zh: 别说是外国人了，就是中国人也很少有人会唱京剧。
body.py: Biéshuō shì wàiguórén le, jiùshì Zhōngguórén yě hěn shǎo yǒu rén huì chàng jīngjù.
body.en: Never mind foreigners — even among Chinese people very few can sing Beijing opera. (外国人 / 唱京剧)

prompt.py: yí suì de háizi —— qí zìxíngchē

answer.zh: 别说一岁的孩子了，就是三岁的孩子也不会骑自行车。
answer.en: Never mind a one-year-old — even a three-year-old can't ride a bike. (model answer)

prompt.py: liùshí suì de lǎorén —— zuò guòshānchē

answer.zh: 别说60岁的老人了，就是很多年轻人也不敢坐过山车。
answer.en: Never mind a 60-year-old — even lots of young people don't dare ride a roller coaster. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 只学了一个月汉语的学生——唱中文歌
prompt.py: zhǐ xuéle yí ge yuè Hànyǔ de xuésheng —— chàng Zhōngwén gē
prompt.en: a student who's studied Chinese for one month — sing a Chinese song

answer.zh: 别说只学了一个月汉语的学生了，就是学了一年的学生也很难唱好中文歌。
answer.en: Never mind someone who's studied for a month — even after a year it's hard to sing a Chinese song well. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 请用“差点儿”描述下面两幅图片内容。
instructions.en: Describe the two pictures using “差点儿”.

items.picture: A young man walking along, about to walk straight into a lamp post; his friend grabs his arm just in time.

answer.zh: 他走路的时候没看前边，差点儿撞到电线杆上。
answer.py: Tā zǒu lù de shíhou méi kàn qiánbian, chàdiǎnr zhuàngdào diànxiàngān shang.
answer.en: He wasn't looking where he was going and nearly walked into a lamp post. (model answer — something bad nearly happened)

items.picture: A road jammed with traffic; then a man running up to a train just as its doors are about to close.

answer.zh: 路上堵车了，他差点儿没赶上火车。
answer.py: Lùshang dǔ chē le, tā chàdiǎnr méi gǎnshàng huǒchē.
answer.en: There was a traffic jam, and he very nearly missed the train (but caught it). (model answer — something good almost didn't happen)

prompt.zh: 说说你经历过什么样的惊险一刻，跟小组同学分享。
prompt.en: Group work: share a breathtaking moment of your own — who, when, where, what happened, what almost happened.

answer.zh: 去年冬天，我在路上骑自行车，路很滑，我差点儿摔倒。
answer.py: Qùnián dōngtiān, wǒ zài lùshang qí zìxíngchē, lù hěn huá, wǒ chàdiǎnr shuāidǎo.
answer.en: Last winter I was cycling and the road was icy — I nearly fell off. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 你看到过或经历过下面的事情吗？你觉得奇怪吗？小组讨论一下原因。
instructions.en: Have you seen or experienced these things? Do they seem strange? Discuss the reasons — then react to each explanation with “我说呢！”.

prompt.zh: 中国人熟人见面常常问“吃了吗”。
prompt.py: Zhōngguórén shúrén jiàn miàn chángcháng wèn “chīle ma”.
prompt.en: When Chinese acquaintances meet, they often ask “Have you eaten?”

answer.zh: A：“吃了吗”其实就是打招呼，不是要请你吃饭。B：我说呢！我每次说没吃，他们都只是笑笑。
answer.py: A: “Chīle ma” qíshí jiù shì dǎ zhāohu, bú shì yào qǐng nǐ chī fàn. B: Wǒ shuō ne! Wǒ měi cì shuō méi chī, tāmen dōu zhǐshì xiàoxiao.
answer.en: A: “Have you eaten?” is really just a greeting, not an invitation. B: No wonder! Every time I said no, they just smiled. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 公园里有老人在下棋，周围围了很多人，可是都静悄悄的，没有人说话。
prompt.py: Gōngyuán li yǒu lǎorén zài xià qí, zhōuwéi wéile hěn duō rén, kěshì dōu jìngqiāoqiāo de, méiyǒu rén shuō huà.
prompt.en: Old men play chess in the park with crowds round them, but everyone is silent.

answer.zh: A：中国有句俗话：观棋不语真君子。B：我说呢！怪不得看下棋的人都不说话。
answer.py: A: Zhōngguó yǒu jù súhuà: guān qí bù yǔ zhēn jūnzǐ. B: Wǒ shuō ne! Guàibude kàn xià qí de rén dōu bù shuō huà.
answer.en: A: There's a saying: a true gentleman watches chess in silence. B: That explains it — no wonder the onlookers don't talk. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 看京剧的时候，常常有观众大喊大叫。
prompt.py: Kàn jīngjù de shíhou, chángcháng yǒu guānzhòng dà hǎn dà jiào.
prompt.en: At Beijing opera, audience members often shout loudly.

answer.zh: A：观众大声叫“好”，是在给演员叫好。B：我说呢！原来他们不是在吵架。
answer.py: A: Guānzhòng dàshēng jiào “hǎo”, shì zài gěi yǎnyuán jiào hǎo. B: Wǒ shuō ne! Yuánlái tāmen bú shì zài chǎo jià.
answer.en: A: The audience shouts “好!” to cheer the performers. B: So that's why — they're not arguing after all. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 这个道理别说大人就是小孩儿也明白。
options.py: Zhège dàolǐ biéshuō dàrén jiùshì xiǎoháir yě míngbai.

options.zh: 这个道理别说小孩儿就是大人也明白。
options.py: Zhège dàolǐ biéshuō xiǎoháir jiùshì dàrén yě míngbai.

questions.explain: The 就是 example (kids) must be the harder case that proves the 别说 one (adults). (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 今天早上堵车，我差点儿迟到。
options.py: Jīntiān zǎoshang dǔ chē, wǒ chàdiǎnr chídào.

options.zh: 今天早上堵车，我差点儿不迟到。
options.py: Jīntiān zǎoshang dǔ chē, wǒ chàdiǎnr bù chídào.

questions.explain: Being late is unwanted: 差点儿迟到 = I was nearly late. There is no 差点儿不. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 这么多工作，别说一天就是一个星期也做不完。
options.py: Zhème duō gōngzuò, biéshuō yì tiān jiùshì yí ge xīngqī yě zuò bu wán.

options.zh: 这么多工作，别说一个星期就是一天也做不完。
options.py: Zhème duō gōngzuò, biéshuō yí ge xīngqī jiùshì yì tiān yě zuò bu wán.

questions.explain: If a week isn't enough, a day certainly isn't — the week goes after 就是. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 我说呢，怪不得这几天没看见他。
options.py: Wǒ shuō ne, guàibude zhè jǐ tiān méi kànjiàn tā.
Wǒ shuō ne, tā chángcháng shēng bìng.

questions.explain: 我说呢 reacts to finally understanding something that puzzled you (not seeing him). (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 我没好好儿复习，所以这次考试差点儿没及格。
options.py: Wǒ méi hǎohāor fùxí, suǒyǐ zhè cì kǎoshì chàdiǎnr méi jí gé.

options.zh: 我没好好儿复习，所以这次差点儿及格。
options.py: Wǒ méi hǎohāor fùxí, suǒyǐ zhè cì chàdiǎnr jí gé.

questions.explain: Passing is wanted and did (just) happen → 差点儿没及格 “I nearly failed”. (grammar note 2)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q4 — review 我说呢 (note 3). Missed Q2 or Q5 — review 差点儿 (note 2). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 别说……，就是……也…… (note 1).
